effect_description_eng:
[Security] At the end of the battle, play this card without paying the cost.
[On Play] [When Digivolving] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP for the turn.
link_effect_description_eng: [When Linking] Until your opponent's turn ends, 1 of their Digimon can't activate [When Digivolving] effects.
